question: The total surface area of a cylinder is 396 {~cm²}, and its radius is 7 {~cm}. Find the volume (in {cm³}) of the cylinder. Use pi=frac{22}7
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Check for **divisibility by 11** as the volume involves π (22/7).

Option (1) 308: 3 + 8 − 0 = 11 (Divisible by 11)

Option (2) 300: 3 + 0 − 0 = 3 (Not divisible)

Option (3) 307: 3 + 7 − 0 = 10 (Not divisible)

Option (4) 314: 3 + 4 − 1 = 6 (Not divisible)

**∴ The correct answer is 308 cm³.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** **Total Surface Area (TSA)** = 396 cm², **Radius (r)** = 7 cm, π = 22/7.

**Formula Used:** TSA = 2πr(h + r); Volume (V) = πr²h

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a8ea8d0802321e793d132e6c6bac065b4364f915f0fb5adcb8fbc040489e8cb7.png] 

⇒ 396 = 2 × (22/7) × 7 × (h + 7)

⇒ 396 = 44 × (h + 7)

⇒ h + 7 = 396 ÷ 44 = 9

⇒ **h = 2 cm**

⇒ Volume = πr²h = (22/7) × 7 × 7 × 2

⇒ Volume = 22 × 7 × 2 = 154 × 2 = 308 cm³

**∴ The correct answer is 308 cm³.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Curved Surface Area of Cylinder

The lateral surface area excluding the top and bottom circles is 2πrh.

Area of Base/Top

The area of each circular face is πr².

Total Surface Area relation

TSA = CSA + 2 × Base Area = 2πrh + 2πr².</p
